title: The affine global derived Hom base-change comparison
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Spec(R), and g:Spec(B)→Spec(R), with X′=X×_Spec(R)Spec(B) and projections f′ and g_X [def-pc-fibre-product]. For perfect M [def-pc-perfect-complex] and K∈D_QCoh(X) [def-pc-derived-category], let E_g be derived extension of scalars left adjoint to exact restriction along g. Regard global RHom [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] over the base rings. Let γ:R𝓗om_X(M,K)→R(g_X)_*R𝓗om_{X′}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K) be the evaluation-mate comparison of [lem-pc-derived-internal-hom-pullback-adjunction], using derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and its direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint]. Let c:RΓ(X,R(g_X)_*(-)) restricted to R → RΓ(X′,-) restricted to B and then to R be the canonical natural isomorphism of the sections/pushforward comparison [lem-pc-derived-sections-pushforward-comparison], with its scalar action retained by the derived direct-image composition mechanism [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition]. It is characterized by compatibility with the right-derived units and the underived identification Γ(X,(g_X)_*F)=Γ(X′,F), acting as identity on sections. Put φ=(restricted RΓ_X)(γ_{M,K}) followed by c at R𝓗om_{X′}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K). Define the affine global derived Hom base-change comparison to be the adjoint of φ under E_g ⊣ restriction, with source E_g(RHom_X(M,K)) and target RHom_{X′}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K) in D(B). This is the canonical comparison of Stacks Tag 0AA7. The canonical choices use the K-flat pullback-tensor computation [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product], the underived pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], its pure-tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], and the sheaf tensor-Hom evaluation [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-hom-adjunction], with the Hom-complex and derived internal-Hom constructions [def-pur-hom-complex] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and the shared derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. The pullback adjunction is the normalized one of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], and the tensor isomorphism satisfies the K-flat coordinate characterization of [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. The tensor/internal-Hom adjunctions have inverse Hom equivalences satisfying the localized Hom-complex evaluation characterization of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection]; their counits equal that canonical uncurrying applied to the identity of internal Hom.

proof.text: For exists_canonicalTensorHomAdjunction, use the chosen canonical tensor-Hom family. Specialize its three-variable naturality to the first and third variables with the middle variable fixed. Feed the inverse equivalences into Mathlib Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. Its homEquiv is the specified inverse family, so the canonical representative characterization transfers unchanged. Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_id identifies the counit with the canonical family applied to identity.

For exists_affineDerivedExtension, specialize mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso to the B-module tensor unit in degree zero. Use CochainComplex.map₂HomologicalComplexFlipObjSingleIso and the left unitor, with naturality and Arrow.isoMk, to transport its first quasi-isomorphism clause to termwise extension of scalars. This supplies Functor.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso. Apply the existing source-library Adjunction.derivedAdjunction to ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj, using ModuleCat functorial flat resolutions and K-injective resolutions. Restriction is exact, so transport its right derived functor along rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory by Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight. The existential witness is the source-library leftDerivedFunctor, not arbitrary data from a new existence theorem.

Fix a as canonicalPullbackAdjunction and bS,bT as canonicalTensorHomAdjunction. The chosen-spec equations supply IsCanonicalDerivedTensorHom for both inverse Hom families. Apply exists_normalizedInternalHomPullbackComparison to these fixed adjunctions, obtaining t and gamma with the canonical tensor predicate and evaluation-mate equation. Apply exists_affineSectionsPushforwardNormalization to obtain the identity s on underived sections and c with the exact right-derived-unit equation. Define phi explicitly as restricted derived global sections of gamma followed by c, and assemble the existential witnesses and all eight required equations. Perfectness, quasi-coherence and qcqs are not needed for the construction, but every original hypothesis stays in the signature.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean assembly of the global comparison, with two proved normalized helpers and no new holes. Preserve the previously landed scalar-extension and tensor-Hom adjunction proofs.

from.place: Affine Hom-out-of-perfect base change: the comparison in D(B)

lean.statement: def affineGlobalHomBaseChangeMap {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (f : X ⟶ Spec R) (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R) [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (M K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hM : Scheme.IsPerfect X M) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj ((schemeGlobalDerivedHomOver f).obj (op M, K)) ⟶ (schemeGlobalDerivedHomOver (pullback.snd f g)).obj (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M), (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj K)
lean.note: Repair X-248f2: pullback adjunction chosen from exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction with the shared derivedPullbackComposition counit; tensor-Hom adjunctions chosen from exists_canonicalTensorHomAdjunction, requiring IsCanonicalDerivedTensorHom for their inverse Hom equivalences and equality of their counits to schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv applied to identity. Tensor comparison retains IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison, not equality to a chosen isomorphism.
